ceu: ✦ The square between Mercury and Pluto

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Think of one small step that brings you closer to your big dream.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between relationships and your career. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Read something that inspires you and keep one sentence.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Take a long bath and imagine the water carrying away the weight of the day.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between family and relationships. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between conversations and routine. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between money and romance. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between your image and family. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between friendships and money. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between your career and your image. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.
